# Exam expansion roadmap

Added `docs/EXAM_EXPANSION_ROADMAP.md` for the next original-content work.

The work is ordered as:

1. TOEIC-style Part 7
2. TOEIC-style listening with device TTS
3. VSTEP-style B1–B2 reading
4. Cambridge A2 Key-style reading
5. Cambridge B1 Preliminary-style reading
6. Limited IELTS-style short academic reading
7. Engine/UI and disclaimer integration
8. Final provenance, licence, manual-QA, device, and release audit

The roadmap explicitly blocks copied official or commercial exam content,
requires provenance and commercial-licence evidence, and keeps incomplete
banks hidden until their review gates pass. No exam data was added in this
roadmap-only change.
